about: The one v2 palette (OTHERS 7.3.1): code layers draw with these colours, and the bake-off's AI layers get them as a reference. Starting values are v1's (sources per entry); they are tuned once, at gate G3 (PLAN_V2 section 10), on the test area. sRGB 0-255. Spec: v2/docs/specs/palette.md.

tunnel.note: Tunnel view (x-ray, v2/docs/specs/tunnel-view.md): the viewer draws the tunnels unlit in these colours over the faded city. One style: a fill, a darker far wall, ink edges, a light centre line; the fill goes towards `deep` by one step per 10 m under the surface.
